texts.NIV84: My son, if you accept my words and store up my commands within you,
texts.KJV: My son, if thou wilt receive my words, and hide my commandments with thee;
texts.NKJV:
My son, if you receive my words,
And treasure my commands within you,
texts.DRB: My son, if thou wilt receive my words, and wilt hide my commandments with thee,

texts.NIV84: turning your ear to wisdom and applying your heart to understanding,
texts.KJV: So that thou incline thine ear unto wisdom, and apply thine heart to understanding;
texts.NKJV:
So that you incline your ear to wisdom,
And apply your heart to understanding;
texts.DRB: That thy ear may hearken to wisdom: Incline thy heart to know prudence:

texts.NIV84: and if you call out for insight and cry aloud for understanding,
texts.KJV: Yea, if thou criest after knowledge, and liftest up thy voice for understanding;
texts.NKJV:
Yes, if you cry out for discernment,
And lift up your voice for understanding,
texts.DRB: For if thou shalt call for wisdom, and incline thy heart to prudence:

texts.NIV84: and if you look for it as for silver and search for it as for hidden treasure,
texts.KJV: If thou seekest her as silver, and searchest for her as for hid treasures;
texts.NKJV:
If you seek her as silver,
And search for her as for hidden treasures;
texts.DRB: If thou shalt seek her as money, and shalt dig for her as for a treasure:

texts.NIV84: then you will understand the fear of the LORD and find the knowledge of God.
texts.KJV: Then shalt thou understand the fear of the Lord, and find the knowledge of God.
texts.NKJV:
Then you will understand the fear of the Lord,
And find the knowledge of God.
texts.DRB: Then shalt thou understand the fear of the Lord, and shalt find the knowledge of God.

texts.NIV84: For the LORD gives wisdom, and from his mouth come knowledge and understanding.
texts.KJV: For the Lord giveth wisdom: out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding.
texts.NKJV:
For the Lord gives wisdom;
From His mouth come knowledge and understanding;
texts.DRB: Because the Lord giveth wisdom: and out of his mouth cometh prudence and knowledge.

texts.NIV84: He holds victory in store for the upright, he is a shield to those whose walk is blameless,
texts.KJV: He layeth up sound wisdom for the righteous: he is a buckler to them that walk uprightly.
texts.NKJV:
He stores up sound wisdom for the upright;
He is a shield to those who walk uprightly;
texts.DRB: He will keep the salvation of the righteous, and protect them that walk in simplicity.

texts.NIV84: for he guards the course of the just and protects the way of his faithful ones.
texts.KJV: He keepeth the paths of judgment, and preserveth the way of his saints.
texts.NKJV:
He guards the paths of justice,
And preserves the way of His saints.
texts.DRB: Keeping the paths of justice, and guarding the ways of saints.

texts.NIV84: Then you will understand what is right and just and fair-every good path.
texts.KJV: Then shalt thou understand righteousness, and judgment, and equity; yea, every good path.
texts.NKJV:
Then you will understand righteousness and justice,
Equity and every good path.
texts.DRB: Then shalt thou understand justice, and judgment, and equity, and every good path.

texts.NIV84: For wisdom will enter your heart, and knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.
texts.KJV: When wisdom entereth into thine heart, and knowledge is pleasant unto thy soul;
texts.NKJV:
When wisdom enters your heart,
And knowledge is pleasant to your soul,
texts.DRB: If wisdom shall enter into thy heart, and knowledge please thy soul:

texts.NIV84: Discretion will protect you, and understanding will guard you.
texts.KJV: Discretion shall preserve thee, understanding shall keep thee:
texts.NKJV:
Discretion will preserve you;
Understanding will keep you,
texts.DRB: Counsel shall keep thee, and prudence shall preserve thee,

texts.NIV84: Wisdom will save you from the ways of wicked men, from men whose words are perverse,
texts.KJV: To deliver thee from the way of the evil man, from the man that speaketh froward things;
texts.NKJV:
To deliver you from the way of evil,
From the man who speaks perverse things,
texts.DRB: That thou mayst be delivered from the evil way, and from the man that speaketh perverse things:

texts.NIV84: who leave the straight paths to walk in dark ways,
texts.KJV: Who leave the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness;
texts.NKJV:
From those who leave the paths of uprightness
To walk in the ways of darkness;
texts.DRB: Who leave the right way, and walk by dark ways:

texts.NIV84: who delight in doing wrong and rejoice in the perverseness of evil,
texts.KJV: Who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the frowardness of the wicked;
texts.NKJV:
Who rejoice in doing evil,
And delight in the perversity of the wicked;
texts.DRB: Who are glad when they have done evil, and rejoice in most wicked things:

texts.NIV84: whose paths are crooked and who are devious in their ways.
texts.KJV: Whose ways are crooked, and they froward in their paths:
texts.NKJV:
Whose ways are crooked,
And who are devious in their paths;
texts.DRB: Whose ways are perverse, and their steps infamous.

texts.NIV84: It will save you also from the adulteress, from the wayward wife with her seductive words,
texts.KJV: To deliver thee from the strange woman, even from the stranger which flattereth with her words;
texts.NKJV:
To deliver you from the immoral woman,
From the seductress who flatters with her words,
texts.DRB: That thou mayst be delivered from the strange women, and from the stranger, who softeneth her words:

texts.NIV84: who has left the partner of her youth and ignored the covenant she made before God.
texts.KJV: Which forsaketh the guide of her youth, and forgetteth the covenant of her God.
texts.NKJV:
Who forsakes the companion of her youth,
And forgets the covenant of her God.
texts.DRB: And forsaketh the guide of her youth,

texts.NIV84: For her house leads down to death and her paths to the spirits of the dead.
texts.KJV: For her house inclineth unto death, and her paths unto the dead.
texts.NKJV:
For her house leads down to death,
And her paths to the dead;
texts.DRB: And hath forgotten the covenant of her God: for her house inclineth unto death, and her paths to hell.

texts.NIV84: None who go to her return or attain the paths of life.
texts.KJV: None that go unto her return again, neither take they hold of the paths of life.
texts.NKJV:
None who go to her return,
Nor do they regain the paths of life—
texts.DRB: None that go in unto her shall return again, neither shall they take hold of the paths of life,

texts.NIV84: Thus you will walk in the ways of good men and keep to the paths of the righteous.
texts.KJV: That thou mayest walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.
texts.NKJV:
So you may walk in the way of goodness,
And keep to the paths of righteousness.
texts.DRB: That thou mayst walk in a good way: and mayst keep the paths of the just.

texts.NIV84: For the upright will live in the land, and the blameless will remain in it;
texts.KJV: For the upright shall dwell in the land, and the perfect shall remain in it.
texts.NKJV:
For the upright will dwell in the land,
And the blameless will remain in it;
texts.DRB: For they that are upright shall dwell in the earth, and the simple shall continue in it.

texts.NIV84: but the wicked will be cut off from the land, and the unfaithful will be torn from it.
texts.KJV: But the wicked shall be cut off from the earth, and the transgressors shall be rooted out of it.
texts.NKJV:
But the wicked will be cut off from the earth,
And the unfaithful will be uprooted from it.
texts.DRB: But the wicked shall be destroyed from the earth: and they that do unjustly shall be taken away from it.
